# Montfort Tadier

Montfort Tadier is the current Deputy of [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). He was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2008.

Montfort Tadier has participated in 6 elections since 2002:

- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier#e10)

  Not elected.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/montfort-tadier.html)
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 2 with 38.1% of the ballot.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 2 with 58% of the ballot.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111016142517/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-brelade-district-2/monty/)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928133637/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=87)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 2 with 36.6% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/montford-tadier/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](http://mtadier.blogspot.com/2014/09/2014-manfiesto-in-500-words.html)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VAtcY7Fimcw)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 2 with 49% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/monty-tadier-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DC_CwGU9BR4)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wHF5KkwtbdE)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/montfort-tadier#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 2 with 47.9% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/monty-tadier/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=idOoRtzO0BA)

Montfort Tadier has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 2](https://flow.je/elections/district-2), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/02/long-standing-st-brelade-deputy-to-stand-again/)\]
